why: The wrapper removed, so Three's bare `Error('Error creating WebGL context.')` escapes untyped. `classifyStartupFailure` decides FATAL vs TRANSIENT from the cause alone and has no way to recognise it, so it resolves to `match-failed`: a dismissable overlay over a Main Menu whose every Start fails identically. Nothing errors, nothing looks broken in the code, and the player retries forever -- which is exactly the residual startup-failure.ts carried before this change.
killedBy: createScene when the browser will not give it a context (issue #325) throws the TYPED failure, not a bare Error
